SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT 'DOOS_AP' AS DOC_TYPE , SO06.CSTMR_ID AS CSTMR_ID , SO06.ORDR_NO AS ORDR_NO FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPMPSO05 SO05 WHERE SO06.CSTMR_ID in ('KRDOOS0004C002', 'KRDOOS0012C002', 'KRDOOP0011', 'KRDOOP0012') AND SO06.ORDR_NO = SO05.ORDR_NO AND SO05.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SO05.SIGN_STATE_CD = 'P' AND ROWNUM =1 GROUP BY SO06.CSTMR_ID , SO06.ORDR_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'D' AS GUBUN , SO06.ORDR_NO AS DATA01 , TO_CHAR(SO06.ORDR_SEQ) AS DATA02 , substrb(SO04.GDS_NM,1,200) AS DATA03 , substrb(SO04.STND_NM,1,500) AS DATA04 , TO_CHAR(SO04.SLS_UNTPRC) AS DATA05 , TO_CHAR(SO06.ORDR_QTY) AS DATA06 , TO_CHAR(SO06.ORDR_QTY*SO06.SLS_UNTPRC) AS DATA07 , SO06.RESGTR_ID AS DATA08 , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM KEPMPSO04 A, ICOMCDDT B WHERE ORDR_RE_NO = SO06.ORDR_RE_NO AND ORDR_RE_SEQ = SO06.ORDR_RE_SEQ AND B.CODE_NO = 'H068' AND B.HOUSE_CODE = '100' AND B.COMPANY_CODE = A.CSTMR_ID AND B.CODE = A.ACCNT_CD AND ROWNUM = 1 ) DATA09 , NVL((SELECT DECODE(A.HRANK_CNSTRCMP_CTGRY_CD, 'CTUA00000001', 'Y', 'N') FROM KEPMDCA15 A, KEPMDCA16 B WHERE A.CSTMR_ID = B.CSTMR_ID AND A.CNSTRCMP_CTGRY_CD = B.CNSTRCMP_CTGRY_CD AND B.CSTMR_ID = SO06.CSTMR_ID AND B.GDS_CD = SO06.GDS_CD) , 'N') DATA10 FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPMPSO04 SO04, KEPMPSO05 SO05 WHERE SO06.ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND SO06.ORDR_RE_NO = SO04.ORDR_RE_NO AND SO06.ORDR_RE_SEQ= SO04.ORDR_RE_SEQ AND SO06.ORDR_NO = SO05.ORDR_NO AND SO05.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SO06.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.PROCE_STATE_CD = 'SS01' UNION ALL SELECT 'T' AS GUBUN , MAX(SO06.ORDR_NO) AS DATA01 , F_SPLIT(MAX(UR01.EMAIL_ADDR),'@',1) AS DATA02 , MAX(ALANC_DEPT_CD) AS DATA03 , TO_CHAR(COUNT(*)) AS DATA04 , NULL AS DATA05 , NULL AS DATA06 , NULL AS DATA07 , MAX(SO06.RESGTR_ID) AS DATA08 , NULL AS DATA09 , NULL AS DATA10 FROM KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPCOUR01 UR01, KEPMPSO05 SO05 WHERE SO06.ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND SO06.RESGTR_ID = UR01.USR_ID AND SO06.ORDR_NO = SO05.ORDR_NO AND SO05.SND_CHK = 'N' AND SO06.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND SO06.PROCE_STATE_CD = 'SS01'
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPSO05 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$'
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPSO05 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = sysdate WHERE ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$'
